title: Daejeon, DJN — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Daejeon, DJN: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Daejeon is a city in DJN with a population of 1,489,000. Korea’s science and technology hub, home to KAIST and numerous research institutes in a green, planned city. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
